name: MSD · BRATS_457
description: Public four-sequence research MRI. Precomputed MONAI prediction; no live model execution in the hosted viewer.

model.name: MONAI brats_mri_segmentation
model.preprocessing: RAS+; 1mm world-space linear resampling; per-channel nonzero z-score; T1Gd,T1,T2,FLAIR
model.inference: 128 cubed sliding window, overlap 0.5, sigmoid > 0.5; ET > TC > WT precedence; nearest-neighbour original-grid restoration

warnings: PRECOMPUTED PUBLIC DEMONSTRATION: the hosted viewer serves this named research case and its precomputed prediction. Uploaded studies are processed only by the local service.
Anatomical and skull-stripping checks are heuristics; they cannot certify that this is a valid brain MRI.
disclaimer: Research and teaching only. Never use model output as a diagnosis.
limitations: Target T4 two-minute budget not benchmarked.
Input sanity checks cannot certify brain anatomy.
anatomy_note: Brain surface extracted from this study. All four sequences are acquired channels from the same public study.
data_credit: Medical Segmentation Decathlon, Simpson et al. (2019), Antonelli et al. (2022). Derived from BraTS 2016–2017; pretraining overlap unverified.
